title: Glass Department Note: Sealed-Unit Reorders and In-House Low-E Cutting for Rebuilt Units — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Note.** For Factory Production Orders, glass recutting sets how the class remake lead time runs for a unit rebuilt after a customer specification remake, by the glass options on the change orders of the window contract the order builds:

1. with a **triple-pane or laminated glass** change order, the sealed units are reordered from the glass supplier, whose sealed-unit lead of **35 business days** runs alongside the frame rebuild, so the glass-and-frame lead is the longer of the class remake lead time and 35 business days;
2. with a **premium low-E** change order and neither of those, the glass is cut in-house after the frame is rebuilt, so the glass-and-frame lead is the class remake lead time plus **2 business days**;
3. with none of them, it is the class remake lead time.

The glass-and-frame lead is counted in whole business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) from the rebuild start date, as part of the remake lead whose end is the remake revised ship date.

## Records read

The change orders are those on the Window Replacement Contracts contract the order builds, by their kind: triple pane, laminated glass, premium low-E.

## Glass-and-frame lead by class (business days)

| Build class | Class remake lead time | With a triple-pane or laminated glass change order | With a premium low-E change order only | With none |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 10 | 35 | 12 | 10 |
| Custom Color Build | 15 | 35 | 17 | 15 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 15 | 35 | 17 | 15 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 20 | 35 | 22 | 20 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 25 | 35 | 27 | 25 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 30 | 35 | 32 | 30 |

A contract carrying both a laminated glass change order and a premium low-E change order falls in the first case.
